segments.name: brokered transportation
segments.description: Operates an asset-light brokered transportation platform, placing shippers' freight with independent carriers and providing managed transportation and last mile services.
segments.evidence: Our operations also include asset-light managed transportation and last mile services, which complement our truck brokerage business.

revenueModel.text: Shippers pay RXO for brokered truckload capacity and related managed transportation and last mile services.
revenueModel.evidence: Shippers create demand for our service, and we place their freight with qualified independent carriers using our technology.
